碰撞不会凭空产生能量，撞完总能量只会减少（变成热、声音和晃动）。: A collision cannot create energy. Some mechanical energy becomes heat, sound, and other motion.
用力拍手时手会变热、还发出声音，这和陀螺碰撞的哪一点一样？: Clapping warms your hands and makes a sound. How is that like a top collision?
运动的能量变成了热和声音: Motion energy becomes heat and sound
碰撞时一部分动能会变成热和声音，所以陀螺撞完转速会掉。: Some kinetic energy becomes heat and sound in a collision, contributing to spin loss.
两只陀螺轻轻擦过和狠狠对撞，哪种转速掉得更多？: Which usually causes a bigger RPM drop: a gentle graze or a hard head-on hit?
撞得越猛，转动的能量越多地变成弹开、晃动、热和声音。: A harder collision typically transfers more spin energy into movement, wobble, heat, and sound.
自行车骑得太慢时为什么容易左右晃？: Why is a very slow bicycle harder to balance?
轮子转得慢，稳住它的角动量小了: Slow wheels have less angular momentum, one contributor to stability
转得快的轮子像陀螺，有更大的角动量，更稳。: Spinning wheels have angular momentum, like tops. Steering and rider balance also matter for bicycles.
陀螺快停下时，它画圈（进动）会怎样？: What happens to a top's wobble as it approaches a stop?
圈越来越小、越来越稳: It gets more upright and steady
转速越低，越难抵抗重力，晃得越来越厉害，最后倒下。: As spin decreases, the top becomes less stable and eventually falls.
“陀螺倒下是因为地面突然变斜了。”对吗？: “A top falls because the floor suddenly tilted.” True or false?
通常是转速被摩擦和碰撞消耗掉了，角动量不够，才会倒下（Spin 停转）。: Usually friction and collisions have reduced its spin until it can no longer stay upright: a Spin Finish.
X 冲刺的速度是从哪来的？: Where does X Dash speed come from?
冲刺完以后，陀螺的转速会怎样？: What happens to RPM after a dash?
一部分转动变成了前进的速度，转速自然会降低。: Some rotational energy becomes forward motion, reducing RPM.
下面哪个和 X 冲刺的原理最像？: Which is most like an X Dash?
🚲 轮子在地上一转，车就往前走: 🚲 A wheel turns against the ground and the bicycle moves
🎈 气球放气往前飞: 🎈 A balloon shoots forward as air escapes
都是“转动 + 抓住地面/齿轨”变成前进。: Both use rotation and contact with the ground or rail to create forward movement.
“齿轨是一台马达，会给陀螺加能量。”对吗？: “The gear rail is a motor that adds energy.” True or false?
齿轨不会加能量，它只是让陀螺把自己的转动换成往前冲。: The rail adds no energy. It helps convert the top's own spin into forward motion.
为什么陀螺最后总会停下来？: Why does a top eventually stop?
轴尖摩擦、空气阻力和每次碰撞都在消耗转动能量，能量用完就停了。: Tip friction, air resistance, and collisions gradually use up its rotational energy.
在桌上转一枚硬币，它为什么越转越慢？: Why does a coin spinning on a table slow down?
桌面摩擦和空气在消耗它的能量: Friction and air resistance dissipate its energy
和陀螺一样，摩擦和空气阻力把转动的能量变成了热。: As with a top, friction and air resistance convert rotational energy into heat and other motion.
同一只陀螺，在光滑的盘子上和粗糙的地毯上，哪里转得更久？: Where would the same top usually spin longer: a smooth dish or rough carpet?
越光滑摩擦越小，能量消耗越慢，转得越久。: Lower friction usually dissipates energy more slowly, letting the top spin longer.
“陀螺停下时，能量就消失得无影无踪了。”对吗？: “When a top stops, its energy disappears.” True or false?
能量没有消失，而是变成了热、声音和空气的运动。: Energy is transformed into heat, sound, and motion of the surroundings; it does not disappear.
同样重的陀螺，重量放在哪里更难被弄停？: For tops of equal mass, where should the weight go to make spin harder to change?
重量越靠外，转动惯量越大，越难被弄停。: Farther from the center means greater rotational inertia.
花样滑冰运动员想转得更快，她会怎么做？: How does a figure skater speed up a spin?
收紧手臂让重量靠近中心，转动惯量变小，就转得更快。: Moving mass inward reduces rotational inertia, so the skater spins faster while conserving angular momentum.
“把配重从外圈挪到中心，陀螺会更持久。”对吗？: “Moving rim weights to the center makes the top last longer at equal initial RPM.” True or false?
挪到中心转动惯量变小，同样的摩擦会更快把它磨停。: Moving weight inward reduces inertia, so the same friction torque stops it sooner in this model.
转动惯量大的陀螺，为什么也更难“发射”到高转速？: Why is a high-inertia top harder to launch at high RPM?
它“转动的惰性”大，难加速也难减速: It resists both speeding up and slowing down
转动惯量就是转动的惰性：越大越难被改变转速，加速和减速都更难。: Rotational inertia measures resistance to changes in angular velocity, in either direction.
哪种轴尖碰地面积最小、转速掉得最慢？: Which bit has the smallest contact and slowest spin loss in this model?
尖轴只用一个小点碰地，摩擦的力臂短，转速掉得慢。: Needle touches at a tiny point, with a short friction lever arm and slow spin loss.
平轴陀螺为什么喜欢满场乱跑？: Why does a Flat-bit top travel around the arena?
抓地强，转动变成了跑动: Strong grip converts spin into movement
平轴碰地面积大、抓地强，像轮子一样把转动变成在场上跑。: A Flat bit grips the floor and can roll like a wheel, converting spin into movement.
哪一双鞋在冰上滑得最远？: Which footwear is made to glide far on ice?
冰刀碰冰的面积很小、摩擦很小，所以滑得又久又远。: Skate blades are designed for low-friction gliding on ice.
“想让陀螺转得最久，就选抓地最强的橡胶平轴。”对吗？: “Choose the grippiest rubber Flat bit for maximum stamina.” True or false?
抓地强摩擦也大，转速掉得快；持久要选碰地小的尖轴。: Strong grip costs spin energy. In this model, Needle favors stamina.
陀螺转得快的时候为什么不容易倒？: Why is a fast-spinning top harder to tip over?
角动量大，重力只能让它慢慢画圈: Its large angular momentum makes gravity turn its axis slowly
转得快角动量大，重力想推倒它时，它只会慢慢进动。: Greater angular momentum leads to slower precession under the same gravitational torque.
不转的陀螺立在尖上，放手后会怎样？: What happens when you let go of a nonspinning top balanced on its tip?
不转就没有角动量来抵抗重力，所以会倒。: Without spin, it lacks the angular momentum associated with gyroscopic stability.
下面哪个也是靠“转起来更稳”？: Which also involves spinning wheels helping stability?
转动的车轮像陀螺一样有角动量，骑得快更稳。: A bicycle's rotating wheels have angular momentum, though steering and rider balance also contribute.
“转得越快，陀螺歪着画圈画得越快。”对吗？: “The faster a top spins, the faster it precesses.” True or false?
恰好相反：转得越快，进动（画圈）越慢、越稳。: The opposite: in this model, faster spin produces slower precession.
潮水一天涨落，主要是谁的引力在拉海水？: Whose gravity is the main driver of ocean tides?
月球的引力拉着海水，大多数海边一天涨潮两次、落潮两次。: The Moon drives much of the tidal effect. Many coasts have two high and low tides per day.
大多数海边一天会有几次涨潮？: How many high tides do many coasts have each day?
地球自转一圈会经过两个“水鼓包”，所以一般一天涨潮两次。: Many coasts pass through two tidal bulges during a rotation, giving two high tides.
什么时候潮差最大（大潮）？: When is the tidal range largest (spring tides)?
新月和满月前后，月球和太阳的引力排成一线，合在一起拉海水。: Around new and full moons, the Sun's and Moon's tidal effects align.
想走沙滩小路上小岛，应该选什么时候？: When is a tidal path exposed?
落潮时海水退去，沙滩小路才露出来。: The path appears when water recedes. Always follow local tide guidance before visiting tidal areas.
你面朝北站着，右手边是哪个方向？: You face north. Which direction is on your right?
面朝北：右手是东，左手是西，背后是南。: Facing north: east is right, west is left, and south is behind.
指南针的磁针为什么总指向北？: Why does a compass align roughly north–south?
因为北边风大: It is windier in the north
地球像一块大磁铁，磁针被它的磁场拉着，大致指向北。: Earth has a magnetic field that aligns a compass needle approximately north–south.
你面朝东站着，背后是哪个方向？: You face east. Which direction is behind you?
东和西是相反的方向。: East and west are opposite directions.
“面朝南站，左手边是东。”对吗？: “When facing south, east is on your left.” True or false?
面朝南时，左手是东、右手是西。: Facing south puts east on the left and west on the right.
在中国，中午的时候影子大概指向哪边？: In much of China, which way do shadows point around solar noon?
北半球中午太阳在南边的天空，所以影子指向北。: At many locations in China, the midday Sun is south, so shadows point north.
因为地球自西向东转，我们看到太阳从东边升起、西边落下。: Earth rotates from west to east, so the Sun appears to rise in the east and set in the west.
傍晚太阳在西边时，你的影子朝哪边？: If the evening Sun is west, which way does your shadow point?
影子总在背着太阳的一边。: Your shadow extends away from the Sun.
“早上影子最短，中午影子最长。”对吗？: “Shadows are shortest in the morning and longest at noon.” True or false?
中午太阳最高，影子最短；早晚太阳低，影子长。: The Sun is highest near solar noon, making shadows shortest. Low morning and evening Sun makes longer shadows.
地图上 1 厘米代表 1 千米，两地相距 3 厘米，真实距离大约是？: A map scale is 1 cm = 1 km. Two places are 3 cm apart. What is the real distance?
比例尺 1 厘米 = 1 千米，3 厘米就是 3 千米。: At 1 cm = 1 km, 3 cm represents 3 km.
地图上的“图例”是用来做什么的？: What does a map legend do?
告诉你地图有多重: Tells you how heavy the map is
图例告诉你山、河、路、灯塔等符号分别是什么。: A legend identifies symbols for mountains, rivers, roads, lighthouses, and more.
一般的地图上，上方是哪个方向？: Which direction is usually at the top of a map?
一般地图上北下南、左西右东（除非另有指向标）。: North is usually up unless a direction marker says otherwise.
比例尺 1 厘米 = 500 米，地图上量到 4 厘米，真实大约多远？: At 1 cm = 500 m, what does 4 cm represent?
海边的细沙主要是怎么来的？: Where does much of a beach's sand come from?
海浪年复一年拍打、冲刷岩石，把它们磨成了沙子。: Waves weather and erode rocks over time, helping produce sand.
沙滩更容易出现在哪里？: Where does sand tend to accumulate?
平静的海湾水流慢，沙子容易堆积成沙滩。: Calmer water in a sheltered bay makes sand deposition easier.
海边悬崖上的“海蚀拱门”是怎么来的？: How can a sea arch form in a cliff?
人用机器挖的: People always dig it with machines
海浪不断冲刷岩石，较软的部分被掏空，留下拱门的形状。: Waves erode weaker sections of rock, sometimes leaving an arch.
海浪一直在磨岩石、搬沙子，海岸会慢慢改变。: Waves continually erode rock and move sand, slowly changing the coast.
夜里船员怎么分辨是哪一座灯塔？: How do sailors identify a lighthouse at night?
每座灯塔的闪光节奏都不一样，数一数就知道是哪座。: Lighthouses have identifying flash patterns that sailors can recognize.
灯塔提醒船只躲开礁石、找到航线，所以建在海边危险处。: They mark coastal hazards and help ships navigate.
为什么灯塔要建得很高？: Why build a lighthouse high above the water?
让很远的船也能看到灯光: So ships can see it from farther away
地球表面是弯的，灯越高，远处的船越能看到。: Earth curves away toward the horizon. A higher light can be seen from farther away.
“灯塔只在白天有用。”对吗？: “Lighthouses are useful only in daylight.” True or false?
灯塔最重要的工作在夜里和大雾天，用灯光给船指路。: Their lights are especially useful at night; other signals and navigation tools also matter in fog.
从海边爬上 1000 米高的山顶，气温大约会怎样？: Climb 1,000 m from sea level. About how much does temperature fall in this model?
海拔每升高 100 米约降 0.6°C，1000 米大约降 6°C。: At 0.6°C per 100 m, climbing 1,000 m gives about a 6°C drop.
“山顶冷，是因为山顶离太阳更远。”对吗？: “Mountaintops are colder because they are farther from the Sun.” True or false?
山顶离太阳只近了几千米，几乎没区别；真正原因是高处空气稀薄，保不住热。: A few kilometers barely changes the distance to the Sun. Air pressure and cooling as air rises are what matter.
山脚 20°C，爬到 2000 米高，大约多少度？: It's 20°C at the foot. At 2,000 m, what does the model predict?
为什么高山顶夏天也有积雪？: Why can high peaks keep snow through summer?
海拔高，气温低到 0°C 以下: High altitude can keep temperatures below freezing
山顶的雪是人运上去的: People carry all the snow up there
越高越冷，高山顶常年低于 0°C，雪化不掉。: High-altitude cold can let accumulated snow survive summer.
雷暴云里的闪电是怎么产生的？: How does lightning form inside a storm cloud?
冰粒和水滴碰撞带电后放电: Colliding particles separate charge, followed by an electrical discharge
积雨云里冰粒和水滴互相碰撞带上电，放电就是闪电。: Collisions among ice particles help separate charge in storm clouds. Electrical discharge produces lightning.
打雷时在山上，最安全的做法是？: During a mountain thunderstorm, what is the safest choice here?
离开山顶和孤立的高处，躲进安全建筑: Leave exposed heights and seek a substantial building
站到最高的大树下: Stand under the tallest lone tree
闪电容易打在高处和孤立的大树上，要尽快离开、躲进建筑。: Exposed high points and lone trees are dangerous in lightning. Seek proper shelter.
雷暴云为什么常常又高又厚？: Why can thunderclouds grow very tall?
暖湿空气猛烈上升、冷却凝结，堆成高高的积雨云。: Strong updrafts lift moist air, which cools and condenses into towering cumulonimbus clouds.
“闪电从来不会打到同一个地方两次。”对吗？: “Lightning never strikes the same place twice.” True or false?
高的地方（比如高塔）会被闪电反复击中。: Tall structures can be struck repeatedly.
看到闪电后数到 3 秒才听到雷声，雷电大约有多远？: Thunder arrives 3 seconds after lightning. Roughly how far away is the flash?
声音每秒约走 340 米，3 秒约 1 千米；光几乎瞬间就到了。: Sound travels about 340 m/s, so 3 seconds is roughly 1 km. Light arrives almost instantly.
为什么总是先看到闪电、后听到雷声？: Why do we see lightning before hearing thunder?
光比声音快得多: Light travels much faster than sound
闪电和雷是同时发生的，只是光跑得比声音快得多。: Lightning and thunder are produced together, but light travels much faster than sound.
数到 6 秒才听到雷声，大约多远？: Thunder arrives after 6 seconds. About how far away is the flash?
闪电和雷声的间隔越来越短，说明雷暴在？: The delay between lightning and thunder is getting shorter. The storm is…
间隔变短说明声音要走的路变短，雷暴正在靠近。: A shorter sound travel time means the lightning is nearer.
积雪年年堆积压成冰，再慢慢往下流: Snow accumulates, compresses into ice, and slowly flows downhill
雪线以上积雪化不完，越积越厚被压成冰，在重力作用下慢慢流动。: Persistent snow builds up and compresses into ice, which flows under gravity.
雪线以上气温太低，积雪终年不化。: Above the snowline, some accumulated snow survives summer.
“冰川是一动不动的大冰块。”对吗？: “A glacier is a motionless block of ice.” True or false?
同样高的山，靠近赤道和靠近北极，哪边的雪线更低？: For similar mountains, where is the snowline generally lower: near the equator or near the poles?
越靠近极地越冷，不用爬太高就能遇到常年积雪。: Colder polar climates allow permanent snow at lower altitudes.
等高线越密，同样的距离高度变化越大，坡就越陡。: Close contours show a large height change over a short distance: a steep slope.
一圈圈闭合的等高线中间，通常是？: Nested closed contours that rise toward the center usually mark a…
越往中间越高、闭合的圈，中间一般是山顶（除非标注是洼地）。: Closed contours rising inward usually indicate a summit, unless depression markings show otherwise.
想找一条最好爬的路，应该沿着哪里走？: Which route is usually gentler to climb?
等高线比较稀的地方: Where contour lines are farther apart
等高线稀，坡比较缓，爬起来更轻松。: Wider contour spacing means a gentler gradient.
一条等高线上的所有点有什么相同？: What do all points on one contour line share?
等高线把同样高度的地方连成一条线。: A contour line connects points of equal elevation.
湿润的风吹向一座大山，哪一边的雨更多？: Moist wind reaches a mountain. Which side usually gets more rain?
风在迎风坡被迫爬升、冷却下雨；翻过山后变干，背风坡少雨。: Air rises and cools on the windward side, producing rain. The leeward side receives drier air.
风爬山时为什么会下雨？: Why can rising air produce rain?
空气上升变冷，水汽凝结成雨: It cools, and water vapor condenses
空气越往上越冷，装不下那么多水汽，就凝结成云和雨。: Cooling air can reach saturation, allowing water vapor to condense into clouds and rain.
背风坡常常是什么样子？: What is a leeward slope often like?
水汽在迎风坡已经下掉了，翻过山的风很干。: Much of the moisture fell on the windward side, leaving drier air beyond the mountain.
“山的两边，雨量一定一样多。”对吗？: “Both sides of a mountain always get the same rainfall.” True or false?
迎风坡多雨、背风坡少雨，两边常常差很多。: Windward and leeward sides can have very different rainfall.
火山喷出来的东西最初来自哪里？: Where does erupted volcanic material originate?
地下深处的岩石熔化成岩浆，从地壳裂缝冲出地面形成火山。: Magma rises through the crust and can erupt to build volcanoes.
它比周围的岩石轻: It is often less dense than the surrounding rock
熔化的岩浆比周围固体岩石轻，会往上挤。: Magma's buoyancy and pressure can drive it upward through rock.
夏威夷这样的盾状火山，山坡是什么样的？: What shape do shield volcanoes such as those in Hawaii have?
稀的熔岩流得很远，一层层铺开，堆成缓缓的“盾牌”形状。: Fluid lava spreads far in layers, building a broad shield shape.
“火山只会出现在陆地上。”对吗？: “Volcanoes only occur on land.” True or false?
海底也有很多火山，夏威夷群岛就是海底火山堆出来的。: Many volcanoes are underwater. Hawaii's islands grew from submarine volcanoes.
地球的板块一年大约移动多远？: About how far do tectonic plates move per year?
板块移动得很慢，每年只有几厘米。: Typical plate motion is only a few centimeters per year.
哪里最容易发生地震和火山？: Where do many earthquakes and volcanoes occur?
板块正中间最平的地方: Only in the flattest middle of a plate
板块边界受到挤压或拉伸，最容易有地震和火山。: Plate boundaries experience compression, extension, and sliding, producing many earthquakes and volcanoes.
两个板块相撞挤出来的: Two plates collided and uplifted the crust
印度洋板块和亚欧板块相撞，地壳被挤高形成高山。: Collision between the Indian and Eurasian plates uplifted the crust into mountains.
地球表面的板块像什么？: What is Earth's plate structure like?
碎成几大块的蛋壳: An eggshell broken into large pieces
地壳碎成几大块“板块”，它们一直在慢慢移动。: Earth's outer shell consists of plates that move slowly.
雨水渗进地下被深处的热岩石加热，再冒出地面成了温泉。: Groundwater warms against hot rock before rising to the surface.
温泉多出现在哪种地方附近？: Where are hot springs especially common?
地下热量多的地方，水更容易被加热冒出来。: Abundant underground heat can warm water that emerges as hot springs.
